definitions.explanation: A large public exhibition displaying industrial, cultural, scientific, or artistic achievements, often international in scale. Visitors view exhibits gathered from many participants; a world's fair is the best-known type.

examples.japanese: {万国|ばんこく}{博覧会|はくらんかい}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: to go to a world's fair.

examples.japanese: その{博覧会|はくらんかい}には{多|おお}くの{国|くに}が{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: Many countries took part in the exposition.

examples.japanese: {大阪|おおさか}で{開|ひら}かれた{博覧会|はくらんかい}には、{半年|はんとし}で{何|なん}{百万|びゃくまん}{人|にん}もの{人|ひと}が{訪|おとず}れた。
examples.english: Millions of people visited the exposition held in Osaka over half a year.

notes:
Combines {博覧|はくらん} (extensive viewing) + {会|かい} (gathering, event). A large-scale public exhibition; the {万国|ばんこく}{博覧会|はくらんかい} (world's fair) is the best-known type, often shortened to {万博|ばんぱく}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {万国|ばんこく}{博覧会|はくらんかい}: world's fair, world exposition
- {博覧会|はくらんかい}を{開|ひら}く: to hold an exposition
- {博覧会|はくらんかい}{会場|かいじょう}: exposition grounds

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {展覧会|てんらんかい}: exhibition — usually of art or particular products, smaller in scope
- {見本市|みほんいち}: trade fair — focused on business and product samples
